objective: Determine whether the exact non-neural empirical-innovation process discovered in CW11.2 improves source-disjoint cave morphology over coherent Gaussian AR across all twelve development caves while remaining fast, diverse, safe after projection, and suitable for the existing engine-neutral cache pipeline.

parents.discovery: Empirical innovation resampling had the best aggregate distance in both frozen CW11.2 exploratory folds.

dataset.split_unit: entire named cave system and acquisition campaign

sampler.identity: Exact CW11.2 empirical_innovation arm, promoted unchanged into its own module.
sampler.algorithm: Fit source-balanced diagonal AR and standardized innovations on the eleven training caves; for every output token choose a training source uniformly, sample one standardized innovation token uniformly from that source, clip to plus or minus four, and integrate the AR equation.

registered_arms.coherent_ar: Retained source-balanced Gaussian AR morphology process.
registered_arms.empirical_innovation: Exact source-balanced observed-innovation resampling process discovered in CW11.2.
registered_arms.measured_reference: Held-out sequence descriptors accessed only by evaluation after both arms are generated.

crossvalidation.new_source_sensitivity: Report and gate the other ten folds separately so the two discovery folds cannot establish success.
crossvalidation.tiny_source_policy: All cave-level folds remain primary; per-source counts and the new-ten sensitivity are explicit.

evaluation.aggregation: Equal weight per named cave; lower distance is better.
evaluation.success_scope: Distribution and CPU-performance pre-gate only; compiled safety and owner visual gates remain mandatory.

post_pass_execution.compiled_candidate: Apply empirical descriptors to the accepted CW10.5 Natural graph and base planes using the unchanged CW11 hard projector.
post_pass_execution.matched_control: Compile coherent AR using the same graph, seed family, source selection, projector, and cache compiler.
required_visuals: Natural versus coherent AR versus empirical innovation compiled 3D volumes
post_pass_execution.minecraft_runtime: No inference; consume the same hash-verified precompiled field cache.

failure_policy.distribution_or_performance_failure: Close CW11 local morphology work negative and retain coherent AR.
failure_policy.compiled_safety_failure: Fail closed and retain coherent AR regardless of distribution metrics.
failure_policy.visual_failure: Retain as research-only process; coherent AR remains product candidate.

claim_limit: Twelve named development caves test a source-balanced statistical morphology process. They do not establish universal cave realism, causal speleogenesis, or performance in another engine without its compiler evaluation.
